task: This is a synthetic newspaper-writing exercise using fictional reporting notes. Use only the supplied reporting notes. Write from the reporting snapshot as of September 8, 2026. Write a headline and a 450–650-word AP-style reported feature about Flint Roof Mushrooms and the delivery, cooling and cost decisions behind growing food close to city customers.

facts.text: An August 2026 dispatch note records Flint Roof Mushrooms moving insulated delivery boxes down a shared freight lift before office tenants began arriving.
The business grows mushrooms in controlled rooms built on a commercial building's roof and serves restaurants and a weekly market.
Founder Omi Carlen employs three part-time workers and rents the growing space from the building owner.
In the supplied trading week, the business harvested 80 kilograms, sold 60 to restaurants and 12 at the market, donated five and composted three.
Restaurant sales were $12 per kilogram and market sales $18 per kilogram, producing $936 in gross sales for the 72 kilograms sold.
Donated and composted output generated no sales revenue in that week's record.
The business pays $800 monthly for the space and reported a $1,300 electricity bill for its latest full month.
A weekly sales total cannot be compared with those monthly bills as though they covered the same period or every operating cost.
Temperature control and cooling require electricity even though customer journeys are short.
The business has not published a full energy-per-kilogram or emissions comparison with mushrooms delivered from outside the city.
Most restaurant deliveries are made by cargo cycle, while a hired van serves a weekly order beyond the cycle route.
A lift outage in July delayed one dispatch and required staff to rearrange a restaurant's delivery window.
Carlen said, "Being close removes some miles. It does not remove the fridge, the lift or the clock."
Restaurant buyer Rella Haver says she values small, frequent deliveries because her kitchen has limited cold storage.
Haver said, "Freshness is useful when the order fits the service we are actually about to cook."
Restaurant orders must be confirmed two days before delivery, and the grower does not guarantee every variety on every date.
The business uses separate lots and dispatch records to trace its own batches; no broader food-safety superiority claim is supplied.
The building's landlord has approved the current space use, but no agreement exists for doubling the farm's area.
The roof formerly held an unused staff terrace, and an old doorway now opens into the packing room.
The owner has not provided a complete profit statement or a plan to supply all of the city's mushroom demand.

forbidden_additions: All 80 kilograms generated retail revenue or $936 is net weekly profit
Local production is proved lower-carbon or requires no cooling and transport infrastructure
